Definition
[The lamination locus $\mathcal T_\gamma $] \group thurston.ch09.interpolationSource: thurston:page-0258Source: thurston:page-0260 For $\gamma \in \mathcal{ML}_0(S)$, let $\mathcal T_\gamma $ be the set of limiting geodesic laminations of negatively curved uncrumpled surfaces whose wrinkling or bending data tends to $\gamma $.
